text:
alex: @support Hey team, ZenoAnalytics reports embeddings endpoint vectors/sec dropped ~60% since yesterday. tokens/sec looks stable. Customers seeing higher latency for batch-heavy jobs, but single-request latencies are normal. project=zeno-prod, model=open-embed-v2, region=us-west-2. Posting their minimal repro and logs below.

maria: Can you paste the example request and any client-side logs? Any 4xx/5xx in our gateway? Any recent deploys to routing/serving?

alex: client example:
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer [redacted]" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"inputs": ["sentence1","sentence2"], "count": 2}' https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings/open-embed-v2
```
client log snippet: "embed_request failed, retrying backoff=200ms, err=401" then later 200. No sustained 5xx.

lee: quick checks from infra: gateway 4xx spike around 03:12 UTC with a handful of transient 401s from the customer's token renewals, but mostly 200. However, GPU pool metrics show a sharp rise in queue depth and a drop in per-GPU throughput around the same window. Batching telemetry shows average batch size dropped from ~16 -> ~3.

maria: That pattern smells like client-side backoff/concurrency collapse. Lower client concurrency causes smaller batches -> vectors/sec falls even though tokens/sec (per request) doesn't change. Ask for a repro script and the exact client version.

alex: sent repro script and client version (zeno-client v1.4.2). Repro steps: run 500 concurrent requests with concurrency=16 vs concurrency=2. Observed vectors/sec 18k vs 7.5k. Attached their raw logs.

oncall-sre: Running the repro on staging now. Observed same delta. Staging GPU util fell from 68% -> 32% with concurrency=2. Server logs show many small batches hitting the serving runtime, which increases per-token overhead (context switch + kernel launch). Found route config: batch_window_ms=2 for this route. With such a small window, small client concurrency underfills batches.

oncall-sre: Also spotted tenant throttling rules for embeddings: tenant_rate_limit_concurrency=2 for zeno-prod due to historical abuse signal. That explains why even when client retries, concurrency is capped and packing suffers.

maria: Workaround options: 1) temporarily raise tenant concurrency to 8 for zeno-prod, 2) advise zeno to increase client parallelism so batch filling recovers, 3) bump batch_window_ms to 10ms on the route to allow more requests to aggregate. Recommend #1+2 short term.

lee: Another oddity: one sample payload returned a vector length of 760 while header X-embedding-dim=768. Looks like a conversion/transcode plugin (quantization path) truncated output in the variant selector for the quantized shard. I pushed a quick guard: on dim mismatch, fall back to the dense variant for that request and log warning.

alex: Gave the customer the recommended client parallelism change and we temporarily increased tenant concurrency to 8. Customer reports partial recovery: vectors/sec up ~48%. They still see some sporadic underfilled batches during short bursts.

maria: I'll create a follow-up ticket with Product to evaluate the tenant limiter heuristic for embeddings (small-dim models should allow higher packing) and to add a fallback if batch sizes under threshold. Also need a postmortem of why the conversion plugin truncated dims.

alex: Customer confirmed latency improved and will apply the client change. Marking this thread as escalated for follow-up. :thumbsup:

supportbot: Incident created: INC-2026-2048, owner=maria, priority=P2.

Notes for oncall: repro script run attached, GPU traces saved to s3://redwood-staging/traces/4965432100. Suggested short-term mitigations applied (tenant concurrency bump + fallback). Long-term: product work + conversion plugin fix.
